question: If BALL is coded as OBEY COMA LORD GULF, then what code can be considered for KITE?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Let us analyze the position of letters of BALL in the given codes.

**B A L L**

**1 2 3 4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f0c7b82e93b76f4c40e8844b3a50bd47a57cc26e180561c692ae7f4577566bf.png] 

Let us examine the options for the code of KITE:

Now check option (3)

**K I T E**

**1 2 3 4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f4770eff33f1ea7812345abf443023763960ccde4a4a943a5fbaa9281466c3.png] 

Hence, the code for KITE in the given code language will be **'SKY BRAIN TABLE GOES'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Let us analyze the position of letters of BALL in the given codes.

 
• BALL → OBEY(2) COMA(4) LORD(1) GULF(3)

Let us examine the options for the code of KITE

 
• KITE → SKILL(2) ROBIN(4) TELL(1) GOAT (No E in GOAT)
 
• KITE → SKIN(2) ORBIT(4) TOTAL (1 and 3) ENTER (1 and 4) 
 
• KITE → SKY(2) BRAIN(4) TABLE(1) GOES (3) 
 
• KITE → SKIP(2) OPTIC(4) TOOL(1) GET (2)

Hence, the code for KITE in the given code language will be 'SKY BRAIN TABLE GOES'.
